in_sanskrit.name: जयान्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जय (jaya) - victory, अन्त (anta) - end, स्वरूप (svarupa) - essence. So, Jayanta means one who is the embodiment of victory or invincible.

in_hindi.name: जयान्त
in_hindi.meaning: जय (jaya) - विजयी (vijayi) - विकत्म (vikatm) - विजयी शक्तिवान (vijayi shaktivan) - विजयी पुरुष (vijayi purush) - victorious, triumphant, invincible, powerful, heroic man.
in_hindi.long_meaning: जय (jaya) - विजयी (vijayi) - विकत्म (vikatm) - विजयी शक्तिवान (vijayi shaktivan) - विजयी पुरुष (vijayi purush) - विजयी (vijayi) - शक्तिवान (shaktivan) - शक्ति (shakti) - power, पुरुष (purush) - man. So, Jayanta means one who is the embodiment of victory or invincible, powerful man.

in_tamil.name: ஜயாந்த
in_tamil.meaning: விஜயம் (vijayam) - விடுதலை (vithudalai) - அவ்விடம் (avvitham) - விஜயம் அவர் (vijayam avar) - victorious, triumphant, invincible, victorious person.

in_telugu.name: జయాన్ట
in_telugu.meaning: జై (jai) - అణ్ట (anta) - జై పోజే (jai poje) - జై పోజే పోజే (jai poje poje) - జై పోజే శక్తిపోజే (jai poje shakti poje) - జై పోజే పోజేపోజే (jai poje poje poje) - victorious, triumphant, invincible, victorious, powerful, heroic person.

in_marathi.name: Jayanta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jayanta is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'jay' meaning victory or triumph. It is a name for a brave and powerful individual, often associated with the gods Indra and Vishnu, who are known for their conquests and victories.
